QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_31

question.text: Per Chapter 11.6, key management personnel (KMP) of an AIF Manager shall INCLUDE all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Members of key investment team of the Manager, as disclosed in the PPM
Employees involved in decision-making — MD, CEO, CIO, Whole-Time Directors, or equivalent
Any other person declared as KMP by the AIF or Manager
The fund's external distribution partners acting purely as sellers

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular (June 25, 2021) reflected in Chapter 11.6, KMP includes (a) key investment team members disclosed in PPM, (b) decision-making employees at MD/CEO/CIO/WTD level, and (c) any other person declared as KMP by the AIF/Manager. External distributors (pure sellers) are NOT KMP. **The Trap:** Distributors sell units but do not make portfolio decisions — they are not KMP for Code-of-Conduct purposes. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same KMP scope in XIX-C/D. XIX-B tests the distributor's own code which is different. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** List KMPs exhaustively in the PPM and update immediately on any senior hire — a common SEBI objection is that a newly-hired CIO or senior PM wasn't reflected in KMP disclosures. Maintain a 'KMP log' with SEBI-intimation dates.
